import PositiveDefiniteTreeLattice.Main.RootedCapacity.Prelude
import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Group.Finset.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Attach

import PositiveDefiniteTreeLattice.Main.RootedCapacity.Defs.rootedCapacity

import PositiveDefiniteTreeLattice.Main.RootedCapacity.Defs.rootedChildComponent

import PositiveDefiniteTreeLattice.Main.RootedCapacity.Defs.rootedChildren
import PositiveDefiniteTreeLattice.Main.RootedCapacity.Defs.rootedGram
-- lean-constellation: managed-imports-end

-- lean-constellation: declaration-source-begin

# lean-constellation target: `rootedChildCapacitySum_attach`

For the existing finite decidable tree `G` with tree witness `hG`, integer weight `w`, and root `ρ`,
use the attached child index
`c : {c : V // c ∈ rootedChildren G hG ρ ρ}`.
Equip each `rootedChildComponent G hG ρ c.1` with the same finite-type and decidable-adjacency
instance convention used for the child blocks in `rootedNonroot_inverse_childBlocks`.

Then the finite sum over attached root children of the diagonal entry at `rootedChildRoot G ρ c.1`
of the rational total inverse of that child component’s existing `rootedGram`, formed with the
restriction of `w` to the component, equals
`rootedChildCapacitySum G hG w ρ`.
The right-hand side remains its existing sum of `rootedCapacity` over the raw Finset `rootedChildren
G hG ρ ρ`; hence this equality is oriented to rewrite the attached-child scalar sum arising from the
canonical Sigma-indexed inverse reduction, without changing either capacity definition or
introducing ambient embeddings.

  `PositiveDefiniteTreeLattice.Main.RootedCapacity.Defs.rootedChildCapacitySum`

  `PositiveDefiniteTreeLattice.Main.RootedCapacity.Defs.rootedChildren`
- `Main.RootedCapacity::rootedGram` → `rootedGram` from
  `PositiveDefiniteTreeLattice.Main.RootedCapacity.Defs.rootedGram`

## Proof outline

Work classically and retain the attached child index
`c : (rootedChildren G hG ρ ρ).attach` throughout the left-hand sum. For each attached child, let
`C := rootedChildComponent G ρ c.1`. Unfold only `rootedCapacity` at the pointwise level: its
value for `C.toSimpleGraph`, the restricted weight, and `rootedChildRoot G ρ c.1` is exactly
the inverse diagonal entry displayed on the left.

Align the local instances used by the two sides before simplifying. Both use
`Fintype.ofFinite C`; the left statement uses `Classical.decRel C.toSimpleGraph.Adj`, while
`rootedChildCapacitySum` constructs its decidable adjacency relation directly from the deleted
edge graph. These are propositionally equal because a `DecidableRel` is a subsingleton. Rewrite
the pointwise term with this `Subsingleton.elim` equality (and proof irrelevance for the retained
finite instance), then unfold `rootedCapacity`; the scalar families agree definitionally.

Use `Finset.sum_attach` to convert the attached-index sum of that pointwise family into the raw
sum over `rootedChildren G hG ρ ρ`. Finally unfold only `rootedChildCapacitySum` and use the
pointwise alignment to identify this raw sum with its existing capacity summands. This proves the
given equality in its rewrite direction, keeps the canonical attached index, and neither unfolds
the child-component partition equivalence nor changes any capacity semantics.

theorem rootedChildCapacitySum_attach {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (hG : G.IsTree) (w : V → ℤ) (ρ : V) :
    Finset.sum (rootedChildren G hG ρ ρ).attach (fun c =>
      let C := rootedChildComponent G ρ c.1
      letI : Fintype C := Fintype.ofFinite C
      letI : DecidableRel C.toSimpleGraph.Adj := Classical.decRel _
      ((rootedGram C.toSimpleGraph (fun x : C => w (x : V)))⁻¹)
        (rootedChildRoot G ρ c.1) (rootedChildRoot G ρ c.1)) =
      rootedChildCapacitySum G hG w ρ := by
  classical
  let q : V → ℚ := fun c =>
    let C := rootedChildComponent G ρ c
    letI : Fintype C := Fintype.ofFinite C
    letI : DecidableRel C.toSimpleGraph.Adj := by
      intro x y
      change Decidable ((G.deleteEdges {s(ρ, c)}).Adj (x : V) (y : V))
      infer_instance
    rootedCapacity C.toSimpleGraph (fun x : C => w (x : V)) (rootedChildRoot G ρ c)
  have hpoint (c : {c : V // c ∈ rootedChildren G hG ρ ρ}) :
      (let C := rootedChildComponent G ρ c.1
       letI : Fintype C := Fintype.ofFinite C
       letI : DecidableRel C.toSimpleGraph.Adj := Classical.decRel _
       ((rootedGram C.toSimpleGraph (fun x : C => w (x : V)))⁻¹)
         (rootedChildRoot G ρ c.1) (rootedChildRoot G ρ c.1)) = q c.1 := by
    simp only [q, rootedCapacity]
    let C := rootedChildComponent G ρ c.1
    let d : DecidableRel C.toSimpleGraph.Adj := by
      intro x y
      change Decidable ((G.deleteEdges {s(ρ, c.1)}).Adj (x : V) (y : V))
      infer_instance
    have hd : Classical.decRel C.toSimpleGraph.Adj = d := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    rw [hd]
  calc
    Finset.sum (rootedChildren G hG ρ ρ).attach (fun c =>
        let C := rootedChildComponent G ρ c.1
        letI : Fintype C := Fintype.ofFinite C
        letI : DecidableRel C.toSimpleGraph.Adj := Classical.decRel _
        ((rootedGram C.toSimpleGraph (fun x : C => w (x : V)))⁻¹)
          (rootedChildRoot G ρ c.1) (rootedChildRoot G ρ c.1)) =
        Finset.sum (rootedChildren G hG ρ ρ).attach (fun c => q c.1) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro c _
      exact hpoint c
    _ = Finset.sum (rootedChildren G hG ρ ρ) q := Finset.sum_attach _ _
    _ = rootedChildCapacitySum G hG w ρ := by
      unfold rootedChildCapacitySum
      rfl
